name: empty-state
title: Empty state
description: Explains why a view has no content or failed to load, and offers the action that changes that.

when: A list or view has nothing to show yet, no results, or failed to load (ErrorState).

guidance.rule: Never blame the user; say what will appear and how to get it.

builtIn: ErrorState's retry button is named "Retry" and shows a pending state.
youProvide: A heading level when the state is the page's main content.

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.description: First use: what will appear here. No results: repeat the query. Cleared: the calm confirmation.

EmptyState.name: headingLevel
EmptyState.description: Renders the title as a heading where the state is the page's main content; a plain line by default.

EmptyState.name: description
EmptyState.description: How the content gets here, or the fix; one or two sentences. Never blame the user.

EmptyState.name: primaryAction
EmptyState.description: The action that fills the view (`Button variant="primary"`), or "Clear filters" for no results.

ErrorState.name: kind
ErrorState.description: Load failed (cloud-off, retry) · not allowed (lock, who to ask) · not found (file-question, way back).

ErrorState.name: title
ErrorState.description: What failed: "Reports could not be loaded".

ErrorState.name: headingLevel
ErrorState.description: Renders the title as a heading where the state replaces the page's main content.

ErrorState.name: description
ErrorState.description: What the user can do. Required: never "Something went wrong" alone.

ErrorState.name: errorCode
ErrorState.description: Shown as "Hata kodu: RPT-504" for support.

ErrorState.name: occurredAt
ErrorState.description: When it failed, shown next to the code in the user's locale.

ErrorState.name: size
ErrorState.description: `compact` for an inline failure inside a card or table cell.

ErrorState.name: announce
ErrorState.description:
Announce the message as an alert. Default: on for `load-failed` (it replaces content the
user was waiting for), off for `not-allowed` and `not-found`, which are usually the page itself.

ErrorState.name: onRetry
ErrorState.description:
Runs the failed load again; the region keeps the user's filters and scroll. A promise
shows the button busy; if it rejects while this state stays on screen, a short
"did not work" line is shown and announced.

ErrorState.name: retryLabel
ErrorState.description: Overrides the localized "Retry" label; the default stays localized.

ErrorState.name: isRetryPending
ErrorState.description:
Shows the retry busy and unpressable while a retry the caller runs itself is under way
, e.g. a query's `isFetching`. A promise from `onRetry` still does this on its own.

ErrorState.name: action
ErrorState.description:
The one way forward when retrying will not help ("Back to dashboard", who to ask).
A `load-failed` state without `onRetry` should still offer a way out here.
